title: Kounain Me Abbas ke Matam ki Sada Hai
body:
Kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
Matam shahe mazloom ka elaane wafa hai, shabbir ke zakhom ki dawa askh-e-aza hai, Zainab ki tamanna hai ye zehra ki dua hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
Farzande nabi kehte the hamshakle nabi se, abjald milado mujhe tum mere aqhi se, tooti hai kamar gham se ajab haal mera hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
Kaasa liye haathon mein badi daie se dar par, hai muntazare aab sakaina meri dukhtar, bedast alamdar hai mashkeeza chhida hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bahaein hai bhateeji ki jo gardan mein chacha ki, tasweer nigaoh mein hai wo ahle aza ki, parcham mein alamdar ke mashkeeza bandha hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
Abbas se kehte the shah-e-deen ye lipat kar, kis tarha se ab haal ye dekhoon maien baradar, shaane hai qalam aanhk mein ek teer laga hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
Kehte the jigar thaam ke sultane do aalam, tadpaegaqhatoone qayamat ko yahi gham, bedast jari ghode se reti pa gira hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
Mazhar ye sada aati hai har tashnagulu se, tahashr zamane mein shaheedaon ke lahoo se, raushan har ek daur mein ye shamme aza hai, kaunain mein Abbas ke matam ki sada hai
